title: Witches
content:
*Cragsend ([[04.06]]) was once ruled by a mage turned Witch Queen.

*Kolfrosta is described as a witch-[[priests|priestess]] ([[03.13]])

*The [[Witch Queen]] of Thring has lived for at least three generations, and created the [[witch-hounds]] and the [[cauldronborn]]
*The [[Witch Clans]] are families that share a magical talent
*[[Alberon]] disguised himself as a woman to learn witchcraft off of the [[Pacharia]] (see [[eleven recognised forms]])
